text_block_list.text:
The first three years with Kiseki came to 
an end.

—And even now, the story of miracles 
continues.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how kind of you. Are you seeing me 
off?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, I was heading to the airport 
with Kiseki. Apparently, Almond Eye is 
about to take on a race in Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not every day you get the chance 
to fire up a rival who's heading off to 
Dubai, after all."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you want to draw manga full of soul, 
you've gotta experience all kinds of 
things!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Let's race again, Ai-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even if you conquer the world, I won't 
back down a single step.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I know. No matter how strong you become, 
though, I will definitely surpass you!

Even after rivals came and went, Kiseki 
continued to thrill people with her 
"story."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki isn't taking the lead?! She starts 
from behind today!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki speeds ahead in top form today as 
well! This is truly her at her finest!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Now then, today's miracle is—!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, who should I root for today!? Almond 
Eye, Daring Tact? Or maybe--

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: —Before that, it's gotta be Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whatever Kiseki decides to do... The whole 
race will change depending on that!

"Whether there is a battle between Triple 
Crown Umamusume, or the dramatic comeback 
of a veteran Umamusume. Even if someone 
departs, or someone new emerges—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, how should I cook up this blazing-hot 
race!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It'd be way more fun if I won after 
all!!"

She always ignited pure frenzy. She shone 
brilliantly. She made everyone believe 
that "something incredible might just 
happen."
Which is precisely why we...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kiseki! I'm totally voting for you in 
the fan poll!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I was so moved by the Japan Cup~ Show us 
another massive runaway lead!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Waaah, thank you so much for cheering!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Still, no telling if I'll front-run next 
time! Look forward to race dayyyy!"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ehh~~?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds fine. Not knowing what 
she'll do is what makes Kiseki so 
interesting.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I might have a late start next time, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh!? I can hear you over there, you 
know--!?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! My bad, my baaaad!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

With every race she runs, Kiseki gathers 
more and more fans.
It's because her charm—

Because it connects to the true essence of 
racing: "You never know what might 
happen."

It never goes according to script. The 
appeal of unpredictable drama— Kiseki 
conveyed it in an even more fascinating 
way.
choice_data_list:
That's why I want to see what happens 
next.

text_block_list.text:
And so, you find yourself heading to the 
racetrack once more, anticipating the next 
drama that will unfold.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kiseki-chaaan!

A little Umamusume holding her mother's 
hand vigorously waved at us.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You know what—! When I grow up, I'm gonna 
run just like Kiseki-chan—!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
! A new rival appears~~?! Now that makes 
me happy~~!
choice_data_list:
Looks like Kiseki's fully on the "admired" 
side now, huh.

Looks like Kiseki's fully on the "admired" 
side now, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, after all, the protagonist is 
always what boys and girls look up to!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she'll copy my special move someday 
too! —Special Move: "Ultra-Sweet Begging 
ZONE Reversal"!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My techniques are limitless!

Drawn in by Kiseki's innocent smile, the 
corners of my mouth curled upward.

Setting aside that move from earlier... 
what would happen if more and more 
Umamusume started copying Kiseki's 
technique?

What if an interesting Umamusume who 
mimicked Kiseki's running style entered 
the race?

There will be times you smile at a 
resemblance. There might even be moments 
where surprise outweighs nostalgia.
Forever and always from here on out—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Hey!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're looking way too far ahead! You 
haven't forgotten that I'm right in front 
of you, have you?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Honestly. Right in the middle of an 
important conversation, too.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Come, Trainer-san. What shall we do next!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can create anything, you know. Leave it 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Because she is the Umamusume you chose to 
be your protagonist.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wait, you didn't notice?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Geez.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Please think back. ...I had quite a few 
things about me that didn't feel very 
'protagonist-like,' didn't I?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Back in the Junior Class, I almost started 
whining a tiny bit about training.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Even after moving up to the Senior 
Year, Ai-chan immediately stole the 
spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Still!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's because you stayed by my side, 
telling me you wanted to see a story with 
me as the protagonist!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because you were watching over me. Because 
you never gave up on me.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because you believed in me... and wanted 
me to be the protagonist—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm able to stand right here right now.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —That is why, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I will continue to deliver this 
"Miraculous Story" to you first and 
foremost!

Kiseki thumps her chest with utter 
confidence. Seeing her like that feels 
remarkably reassuring.
choice_data_list:
I wonder what kind of story the next one 
will be.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Yeah, that's true...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Like winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
and becoming number one in the world! Or 
racing against a fully recovered 
Kita-chan!
choice_data_list:
And take down Almond Eye while we're at 
it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All at once... haha! You mean like a 'True 
Ultimate Showdown' arc?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that sounds super hype! That might 
be crazy fun!

Together, Kiseki and I let our 
imaginations run wild with all kinds of 
possible futures, one after another.

Now, what kind of story should she and I 
create next?
